description: This Java source file defines the BOMHelper class, which provides static utility methods for handling product bills of materials, including calculating maximum depth, detecting duplicate ancestors, and creating production runs for shipments within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: BOMHelper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for managing product BOMs, including depth calculation, ancestor duplication detection, and shipment production run creation.

methods.name: getMaxDepth
methods.description: Recursively calculates the maximum depth of a product in the BOM hierarchy based on parent associations.

methods.name: searchDuplicatedAncestor
methods.description: Finds a duplicate ancestor for a product to prevent loops when adding components to a BOM.

methods.name: createProductionRunsForShipment
methods.description: Creates production runs for a shipment by invoking a service, handling errors, and logging.
